entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and warrior who proposes that the four planeswalkers stay and keep watch against threats to the Multiverse.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage planeswalker who first urges caution and considers leaving Zendikar, then swears the oath.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who refuses to leave Zendikar and swears to keep watch.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who rescued the others and joins the oath after initial reluctance.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A commander left with a small group of soldiers a couple of miles away, who knows the remaining resources.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: The demon who imprisoned the planeswalkers in agony before they were rescued.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ancient dragon planeswalker who thought the Eldrazi could not be killed.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that leaves trails of bony dust.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that leaves trails of gleaming stone in square spirals.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The third Eldrazi titan, whose location is unknown; Jace fears it drifts through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The alien invaders that swarm Zendikar.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The pact of Gideon, Jace, Nissa and Chandra to stand together against threats to the Multiverse, sworn by the oath to keep watch.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on the verge of collapse under two titans.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The ruined city whose fall Gideon swears never to see repeated.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane Gideon thinks of as at risk.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara Gideon thinks of as at risk.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A city-plane that Jace fears would be laid waste.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: The plane where Gideon knew Chandra bound by a commitment.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which Emrakul could be drifting.

events.summary: Gideon leads the planeswalkers out of the cavern and they scatter the Eldrazi swarm at the cave mouth.
events.quote: Gideon was the first to emerge from the cavern

events.summary: From the mountains Gideon sees the ruin of Sea Gate and the two titans creeping across the land, and realizes his army is gone.
Jace stops Gideon from making empty promises to a distraught Nissa.
events.quote: Don't make promises you can't keep,

events.summary: Jace suggests leaving Zendikar to its fate, and Nissa refuses and the ground trembles.
Gideon realizes none of them have left and argues that together the four can stand against the Eldrazi.
events.quote: But maybe four of us can,

events.summary: Gideon swears an oath to keep watch against all threats to the Multiverse.
events.quote: For Sea Gate, for Zendikar and all its people, for justice and peace, I will keep watch.

events.summary: Nissa swears the oath to keep watch.
events.quote: for the life of every plane, I will keep watch.

events.summary: Jace swears the oath, warning that Emrakul could be drifting through the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: Never again. For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch.

events.summary: Chandra swears the oath, saying every world has its tyrants, and Nissa embraces her.
events.quote: If it means that people can live in freedom, yeah, I'll keep watch.

events.summary: The four set out to find Tazri and form a plan.
events.quote: I left Tazri and a small group of soldiers a couple miles back that way.

relations.note: Gideon proposes and swears the oath.
relations.quote: I will be there, with you three beside me.
For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch.
for the life of every plane, I will keep watch.
yeah, I'll keep watch. With you.

relations.note: The four commit to standing against the Eldrazi and other threats.
relations.quote: Together, we can take down the Eldrazi.

relations.note: Jace says Ugin thought stopping the Eldrazi impossible and has more experience with them.
relations.quote: Ugin thought so, and he has more experience with the Eldrazi than we will ever have.
